items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: I was in the Hickory House for years with Toshiko you know.

ctx.x: Well you eventually went and played with Marian.

Yeah. Well I went into Swing music forever. I never went back to the bebop thing. Never went back to it, I never went back, no. I went out with Marian, right after that I went with her trio, for years. I was in the Hickory House for years with Toshiko you know. I was with Maynard Ferguson at Birdland and things like that. Once I got with these guys, that was it. That was it. I headed for John Bunch and Count Basie, playing with Count in a little combos you know, oh, Dave McKenna, and after Marian I went right…
Well do you know what it was about your playing that they liked?
